title: Uncertainty documentation without scoring
content: Uncertainty documentation can describe which contextual details are absent and which assertions conflict. This synthetic text uses descriptive statements rather than numerical confidence, probability, or a risk score. A research note can distinguish lack of evidence from disagreement between available sources. Retrieval does not resolve either limitation by returning a fluent passage. Uncertainty language in a document is part of the source text, not a computed system assessment. This topic is included to evaluate searches about limitations and unresolved information. No uncertainty engine or decision threshold is defined. Synthetic research evidence only. Retrieval relevance != clinical validity.
